validationStatus: RC54 verifies the shared failure structure in a held-temperature EOL test; the proposed longitudinal-frailty remedy remains exploratory and requires a new independent source.
sharedBottleneck: A model can rank operating conditions while remaining unable to identify cell-level susceptibility or extrapolate a censored mechanism into a temperature where that mechanism reaches EOL. Adding many early coordinates cannot recover an unobserved condition-by-mechanism interaction, and missing diagnostic coordinates can erase the replicated comparisons needed to detect it.

registered: The common complete target contains 44 of 57 held 40-degree cells; 36 reach the registered 80% EOL.
No complete development calendar cell reaches 80% EOL, while three complete target calendar cells do; calendar MdAE is above 10,500 days in every arm.
Stress-only pooled Harrell concordance is 0.8476, but within-condition concordance is 0.500 over 27 comparable pairs.
The static passport lowers pooled MdAE from 226.22 to 166.53 days but worsens the calendar boundary, so H1 is rejected.
The capacity-response and full perturbation-response arms have MdAE 298.45 and 240.46 days; all H0-H3 verdicts are rejected.
Thirteen target cells lack at least one registered early EIS response, independently failing complete-coverage and minimum-pair gates.
Python and dependency-free Node agree across 850 deterministic values within 1.1817e-8.
exploratory: Across every target cell with the individual coordinate available, 30%-SOC 10 ms pulse response reaches within-condition concordance 0.6444 over 45 pairs.
One-week capacity response reaches within-condition concordance 0.6222 over 45 pairs, even though the pooled Weibull capacity-response arm worsens magnitude and calibration.
D beats C in pooled median error but worsens individual absolute error in 25 of 36 event cells; its 2,000-condition-bootstrap improvement interval is -0.826 to 0.361.

holdsWhen: Operating conditions have replicated cells so condition means and within-condition frailty can be separated.
Longitudinal observations precede the endpoint and retain right censoring instead of replacing it with a fabricated life label.
The observation operator and missingness rule are frozen before target outcomes.
An accelerated condition can activate a mechanism that is censored in development conditions.
Pooled prediction, within-condition order, family transport, calibration, and feature coverage are independent gates.
breaksWhen: Every condition has only one specimen or condition is perfectly confounded with lot and laboratory.
A direct mechanism measurement makes frailty fully observable before aging.
Censoring is informative but modeled as administrative, or target rows with missing sensors are silently removed.
The high-temperature mechanism is absent at service temperature, so an acceleration law has no common physical basis.
A post-outcome feature is reused as if it were a prospective independent test.
transferableMethod: Fit a two-level joint longitudinal-survival model: a physically constrained condition-level degradation trajectory uses all pre-EOL check-ups, while a single preregistered early capacity or pulse coordinate estimates within-condition frailty. Treat missing diagnostics as an observation-process problem, require explicit abstention, and confirm on a new source whose outcome has not been opened.
surfaceSimilarityRisk: RUL, digital twins, and accelerated qualification all contain time series, but the connection is substantive only when a condition law, specimen frailty, censoring, observation operator, and independent endpoint can be mapped separately.
minimumValidation: On a new same-chemistry source, freeze one or two response coordinates before outcomes; achieve at least 90% target feature coverage, at least 30 comparable within-condition EOL pairs, within-condition concordance at least 0.60, held-condition MdAE at most the declared practical bound, calibration error at most 0.15, and an independent implementation match. Stop the electrochemical-only route if either coverage or within-condition order fails.
